review: Six Coroa identities preserved from reference portraits, with distinct authority, iron judgement, spectral absence, inherited chains, ash command and captive resistance. Each character uses different locations within the fallen empire.

Six scenes and camera framings per character, with varied Coroa locations. A visible identity anchor connects portrait, passive and abilities. Sovereign passive and defense backgrounds were edited for clearer interior/exterior variety. The Judge uses the same cylindrical gavel across her scenes.
Source-scale anatomy, accessories, attack direction and target counts reviewed; sprites checked at 75px.
Personal invulnerability protects only the caster. Empty Throne counter protects one ally; Empty Throne and Regent team buffs show exactly the caster plus two allies.
